caption: The drawing features a single piece of furniture, a table, centrally placed on a cream or beige background. The table is depicted in a crimson or dark red color, showcasing wood texture with visible grain lines. The tabletop has a unique, non-rectangular shape with two outward curves on the sides and a semicircular indentation along the front edge. The table stands on four slender, tapered legs. At the bottom of the drawing, there are two smaller sketches: one on the left showing the top view of the table with labeled dimensions (33" wide, 18" deep, 28" high), and one on the right showing a front view with additional dimensions indicated. The name "MEYERS" is handwritten near the bottom left. The entire drawing is enclosed within a faint rectangular border.
title: Card Table
